posts.name: Adventurer
posts.cooked:
Three different decor recipes for the enchanter profession (Midnight):

Spellbound Tome of Thalassian Magics
Endless Codex of the Voidtouched
Endless Codex of the Blooming light

All of these ARE THE SAME piece of decor: a floating, animated tome, with pages turning and a purple glow/aura…

Please tell me this is a bug…
I was so excited to hear that the professions were getting recipes to create decor; now I’m thinking the developers involved in (this specific case) are trolling people who are enthusiastic about housing in WoW…
How can I not think the worst?
Logic prohibits the path.
If these three recipes were made different because players have limited access to materials, then the logical approach would be to have a single piece of decor that can be made 3 different ways.

Giving multiple recipes different names and different materials that result in the exact same outcome is disingenuous, hence the capd title of the topic: [ F R A U D ]

I am also considering the theory the devs are simply lazy…for instance:
Endless Codex of Blooming Light should, at the very least, have a golden/yellow glow/aura…(and I’d probably be content with that–even if the tome itself is identical)
I want the community to know, although I am being critical here, I actually LOVE the floating tome and have made 2 already. I just want Blizzard to be honest with me about what I’m getting… It’s like ordering fries, potato chips, and curly fries from the menu and your waiter brings out 3 bags of potato chips..

now I’m hungry.

OR…
this is a bug that needs to be fixed.

Does anyone know the answer to this question? (crosses fingers for bug*)

5/13/2026
UPDATE:
I have made the Thalassian magics and Codex of blooming light:
The preview is bugged and shows the same decor, but the decor itself is different in that it does have a different aura and is interactable. Thanks to Enabler for your comment!

Enabler:

Those decor’s have a gimmick. The actual decor is the same, but they have a slight aura that distinguishes them and more importantly they are interactable and give you a conjured version of the cosmetic shoulder enchant they are named after that lasts 20 minutes when you interact with them. well not the thalassian magics that one is special in that it does nothing and is not special, but you forgot to mention the holy tome that also looks the same and gives out the light illusion for shoulders

and to comment further…

Enabler:

Tbh I thought the same but i was collecting decor at the time, having a free enchant dispenser was cool enough that I forgvae it.

After interacting with the “free enchant dispenser” I am much less annoyed by the similarities… This is an awesome feature, but I still want variations beyond bells and whistles: the tomes have the same binding, decor, shape, size, and color…
Aesthetics, in WoW decor theory, are superior to gimmicks (not to be confused with functionality).
WoW decor theory…now there’s a winner college course for ya…
